2027-03-01.name: Daily #151
hints: The beam already passes close to the seed. One mass beside it can pull it across.
The marked sphere holds the mass, about a third of the way along the star's beam.
A medium mass with its shadow just clear of the beam, about a third of the way along the star's beam, turns it onto the seed. Keep the beam out of every shadow: light that crosses one is swallowed.
2027-03-01.teach: The closer the pass, the harder the bend, until the shadow swallows the light.
